# MIDI File

## Summary
The FileDef specialization for MIDI sequences.
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `FileDef`. Adds `duration` and `midi` (`MidiMetadataField`) and extracts them from the header and
track chunks — format type, division, track count, tempo and time signature.
Unlike the sampled audio defs it carries no waveform: a MIDI file is
instructions, not samples, so its `previewComponent` renders the track
structure.

Accepts: `.mid, .midi, audio/midi, audio/x-midi`

## Example
```ts
import { MidiDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/midi-audio-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(MidiDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
